gpts_exposure.selection_rule: Read this catalog, select only allowlisted operations and managed modes, and create one validated compute ticket per dependent stage.

runtime_packages.numpy: deterministic arrays, linear algebra and simulation
runtime_packages.scipy: optimization, probability, statistics and scientific algorithms
runtime_packages.shapely: planar geometry and vector spatial operations
runtime_packages.pandas: isolated tabular data used by registered packs
runtime_packages.statsmodels: regression, forecasting, state-space, meta-analysis and diagnostics; exact version 0.14.6
runtime_packages.SALib: Sobol global sensitivity analysis; exact version 1.5.2
runtime_packages.OR-Tools: bounded MIP, assignment and vehicle routing; exact version 9.15.6755
runtime_packages.NDlib: isolated diffusion and opinion-dynamics method pack; exact version 5.1.1
runtime_packages.DoWhy: isolated causal model-identify-estimate-refute method pack; exact version 0.14
runtime_packages.pgmpy: isolated discrete Bayesian-network method pack; exact version 1.1.2
runtime_packages.DuckDB-Polars-PyArrow: bounded columnar and relational evidence processing
runtime_packages.Pandera-Pint: schema, range, unit and dimensional validation
runtime_packages.scikit-learn: bounded segmentation, classification and model validation
runtime_packages.PyMC-ArviZ: hierarchical Bayesian inference and convergence diagnostics
runtime_packages.Xarray-Rasterio-rioxarray: bounded raster and geospatial array analysis
runtime_packages.PyOD: 3.6.2; classic allowlisted ECOD, IForest and KNN anomaly screening only
runtime_packages.repository-native-assurance: forecast scoring, calibration, interval validation, realized-outcome feedback, cross-model agreement, VV&A and bounded linear state estimation
runtime_packages.Eclipse SUMO: 1.27.1; isolated bounded road, transit and logistics micro-simulation
runtime_packages.SageMath: 10.9 official image pinned by exact repository digest; Docker network=none, read-only root and no-new-privileges

target_scope_gaps: domain-real benchmarks for all newly introduced controlled-preview modes
long-running shadow validation and realized-outcome feedback
specialized multi-physics digital-twin and military-grade wargaming backends
scope: decision comparison, Monte Carlo, sensitivity and scenario analysis
cost, break-even, operating analytics and bounded optimization
queue, process, Markov, nonlinear, system-dynamics and agent-based simulation
vector and bounded raster GIS, spatial statistics and remote-sensing summaries
Bayesian inference, hierarchical Bayesian models and Bayesian networks
econometrics, panel models, survey weighting, meta-analysis and policy microsimulation
financial performance, robust portfolio risk, backtesting and capital budgeting
consumer choice, price elasticity, customer value, churn, segmentation and marketing analysis
inventory, quality, input-output and supply-chain shock analysis
multi-objective decisions, influence diagrams and strategic sandbox simulation
missingness, schema, units, evidence quality and calibration governance
group-level behavioral scenarios, information diffusion and policy causal evaluation
crisis risk scoring, threshold optimization, escalation and resource allocation
reliability probability, control response, surrogate modeling and experimental design
process mining, spatial lag econometrics and heterogeneous causal-effect estimation
GARCH volatility, conformal intervals and scenario-robust allocation
transport shortest paths, epidemic compartments and fixed-template system dynamics
strategic games, negotiation, policy counterfactuals, entity resolution, evidence graphs and structured intelligence analysis
fixed derivatives and bond analytics, active-inference choice, classic anomaly screening, market-basket rules, evolutionary strategy and bounded group-behavior scenarios
forecast scoring, calibration diagnostics, prediction-interval validation, realized-outcome feedback, benchmark comparison, cross-model agreement, VV&A and bounded generic state estimation
exact symbolic algebra, equation solving, calculus, matrix invariants and number theory in a pinned offline SageMath runtime
bounded large-scale blocking, sort-and-sweep, streaming numeric profiling and sparse graph summaries
not_intended_for: individual psychological diagnosis or deterministic individual prediction
autonomous emergency command or unverified real-world alerts
automatic causal claims after failed identification or refutation
real-time social account targeting or automated information operations
unbounded global raster processing or live remote-sensing pipelines
large or real-time vehicle routing and fleet dispatch
deep learning or high-frequency online optimization
unrestricted probabilistic programming, arbitrary model code or runtime package installation
live market-data collection, personalized suitability advice, guaranteed returns, brokerage execution or automated trading
live person or military target tracking, weapons integration or autonomous operational control
toolkit_assessment.dependency_policy: Compute Capability Manager V2 resolves only repository-pinned dependency bundles. Production workflow writes a runtime plan before installation and execution.
toolkit_assessment.extension_policy: Register fixed allowlisted operations or modes with bounded inputs, pinned dependencies, maturity, determinism, network policy, resource limits, tests, benchmarks and rollback metadata.

operations.use_when: inputs are uncertain and ranges or distributions are available
parameter effects must be measured
discrete policies or assumptions must be compared
an objective must be optimized under fixed constraints
fixed cost, price and variable cost are known
observations need summary statistics
queues, service capacity or process timing matter
strategies interact repeatedly
strategy shares evolve under a payoff matrix
ordered observations support a basic bounded forecast
candidate relationships require non-causal screening
fixed nonlinear state equations require simulation
structured data require deterministic pattern screening
assumptions must be checked against ranges or evidence
states change according to a transition matrix
coordinates or GeoJSON require CRS-aware vector computation
operations.typical_output: distances, transformed coordinates, overlays, predicates or nearest matches

operations.use_when: priors and observations must be combined
operations.typical_output: posterior parameters, credible and predictive intervals

operations.use_when: observational data require regression or identification diagnostics
operations.typical_output: coefficients, robust inference, fit and identification warnings

operations.use_when: financial, commercial, econometric, policy, social, strategic, spatial or intelligence evidence requires bounded institutional-style analysis
operations.typical_output: validated evidence tables, statistical estimates, forecasts, risk-return metrics, operating insights, policy distributions, spatial statistics, optimized decisions, simulations and diagnostics

operations.use_when: heterogeneous agents, local interaction, social mechanisms, switching, congestion or resource competition matter
operations.typical_output: population trajectories, adoption, trust, compliance, risk perception, rewards, stocks and group differences

operations.use_when: missingness, complete-case bias, multiple imputation or data collection priority must be assessed
operations.typical_output: missingness profile, explicitly marked imputed values, uncertainty and collection priorities

operations.use_when: stocks, flows, feedback, delay, capacity or path dependence drive long-run behavior
operations.typical_output: state trajectories, conservation checks, bottlenecks, depletion and saturation

operations.use_when: risk indicators, alert thresholds, escalation or response allocation require bounded quantitative support
operations.typical_output: risk score, alarms, decision-loss threshold, escalation probability, allocation and warning metrics
restrictions: high-stakes use requires independent validation and user approval

operations.use_when: structured networks require bounded propagation, adoption, cascade or opinion-dynamics analysis
operations.typical_output: multi-seed trajectories, final reach distribution and network sensitivity evidence

operations.use_when: a policy effect requires explicit identification assumptions, estimation and refutation
operations.typical_output: effect estimate, overlap or pretrend diagnostics, weak-IV checks, placebo evidence and claim status

operations.use_when: structured discrete evidence requires DAG validation, posterior inference, parameter estimation or EM
operations.typical_output: posterior factors, validated CPDs, evidence sensitivity and virtual-evidence updates
restrictions: expert prior remains labeled as prior

operations.description: 断网执行因果机器学习、马尔可夫链、双矩阵博弈、深度不确定性稳健决策、电力系统、电网潮流、水力网络、水资源分配、地质统计和生命周期评估。
operations.dependency_policy: 每个模式只安装一个仓库固定的精确版本依赖包；禁止票据指定包或模块。
required_evidence: 数值收敛或可行性状态
独立验证或冻结基准后方可用于正式决策

operations.description: 断网执行博弈、谈判、市场竞争、营销配置、金融政策反事实、量化定价、异常筛查、实体消歧、证据图谱、群体行为机制和公开结构化情报分析。
operations.dependency_policy: 每个包支持模式只安装仓库固定的精确版本依赖；纯方法模式仅使用核心数值栈。
required_evidence: 输入字段、权重、规则、时间和实体范围
依赖引擎版本与模式回执
涉及个人数据时必须具备合法来源、用途限制和最小化证明
高风险决策必须独立验证并由人类批准

operations.description: 断网执行SUMO结构化交通微观仿真与StatsForecast批量统计预测。
operations.dependency_policy: 按模式安装仓库固定精确版本；禁止票据指定包、命令、脚本或文件路径。
required_evidence: 输入结构、单位、时间范围与频率
固定随机种子或预测基准
独立验证或冻结基准后方可用于正式决策

operations.use_when: exact symbolic simplification, equation solving, calculus, matrix algebra or number theory are required
operations.typical_output: exact symbolic expressions, solutions, derivatives, integrals, matrix invariants or number-theory results

operations.use_when: large structured datasets require bounded collision, comparison, profiling, timeline or graph analysis
operations.typical_output: complexity profile, candidate-limited matches, conflict summary, column profile or sparse graph ranking

safety_boundaries: no live brokerage, order placement, personalized suitability or guaranteed-return claims
no autonomous behavioral agent loop, individual psychological diagnosis or real-group deterministic prediction
no persuasion targeting, information operations or automatic enforcement from anomaly scores
